text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Уиннинг Тикит and I
return to
the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taishin, Hayahide, I'm back! Let's go
play futsal!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Say what? Why futsal all of a sudden?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Cause I saw some people playing it
today, and it
got me all excited!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Experiencing new exciting things will
make me
stronger! So let's get to
futsalling!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: But Ticket, do you even know the rules?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Sure do! My dad told me about it
before.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
He's a pro sports trainer, so he knows all
kinds of
stuff.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, a professional Тренер? That's
interesting.
What does he specialize in?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm not sure! But he's pretty
awesome at
everything!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'm not sure why I expected you
to at least
know what your own father
does...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Ticket's enthusiastic—and
somewhat
forceful—invitations, she
gathers players in no
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
WOO! It's finally time to kickoff! Isn't
futsal
great?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
This is it! It sets my heart pounding in a
different
way from racing! This is what I
was looking for!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Different from racing? They're both
sports, so
what's the difference exactly?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: That's easy! The difference is...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That I get to be on the same team as you
and
Taishin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Normally, we'd be opponents in a race,
right? So
when one of us wins, that
means the others lose.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But in futsal, the three of us can win
together!
Isn't that awesome?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Celebrating victory with my besties will
be the
best thing ever! Yeeeaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I think I understand now. She has a
point.
Wouldn't you agree, Taishin?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: One point doesn't make a victory...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
So what are our positions? We can't start
until we
decide that.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed. It may not be a deciding
factor in
whether we win or lose, but
what position Ticket
plays will be a key
component.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Let's get some advice from her trainer,
shall we?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So many options! I wanna play the most
exciting
position!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, where should I be? Huh, huh?
What do
you think?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ohh, striker! That's the player in front
who gets to
shoot the ball!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Every point scored would make it more
and more
exciting! Yeeeah, I'll do it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: The referee whistles the start signal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm bringing the ball right in front
of the
goal. Ticket, here! Come on, take
the shot!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Taaake this! JUMPING... NO TRAP...
WINNING
SHO—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: It's mine!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Gaaah! My ball!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Idiot! Don't just stand there
talking—make the
shot!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Ticket... Was that narration
really
necessary?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Sniffle... Yeah, it's importaaant!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Saying the line right before you get the
goal is
the most moving way to score!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, at least have a logical
strategy. If
the ball gets stolen before
you make the shot,
you'll never achieve
victory.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Got it! Then next time... I'll get it for
suuuure!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Once more, Уиннинг Тикит aims for the
goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
LET'S GO! JUMPIIING... NO TRAP...
WINNING
SHO—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Everyone, slide tackle! Get her!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
You dumbass! You did the exact same
thing!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Raaaagh! Even if everyone tries to tackle
me...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'll be fine if I just persevere! Wraaaagh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит evades the onslaught of
sliding
tackles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She managed to dodge them all... And
without a
strategy. What a feat.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll make it this time! JUMPIIING! NO
TRAP!
WINNING SHOT!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Whoa! That speed!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
No one can stop it. Ticket's power is
incredible.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Filled with the tremendous spirit of her
special
attack, the ball flies like
lightning...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...far above the goal and into the
distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! No WAAAAY!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: After a great setup like that, you miss? Well, I guess you moved me to feel something, all right.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, keeper! If I stop all the balls that
come my
way, it'll definitely move the
audience!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, with Ticket's core strength, that
seems like
a suitable choice. Let's go
with that formation.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: The game begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taishin, I'll pass to you. Get it to the
goal!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll slip past the defense, and—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Move it, move it! Yeeeaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ticket?! Why's the keeper out on the
field?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You know... After seeing you play, I
wanted to
shoot the ball so bad!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Taishin, Hayahide, that's it! Can I be a
keeper
who also attacks?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Well, keepers have sometimes been known to take penalty kicks, but it's not exactly conventional...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Regardless of convention, Winning
Ticket runs
around playing both defense
and offense.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaah! Attack, then defend, then attack
again!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
She dances around the field like a
brilliant
prodigy!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Geez, she's so fast I can barely see her...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, with that speed, crossing the field
and
playing both positions is actually an
option.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I can do it! I'm doing it! I can play both
positions!
YEEAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Counter offense! Now, while
their
keeper is away!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Right!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text: Huh? A counter-what now?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: NOOOO! We totally lost!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The game was messy but exhilarating,
and Ticket
learned how to deal with
sliding tackles using
sheer guts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The opponent's clever strategy led to
their
inevitable defeat... But at least
Ticket gained
some impressive speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
